The test image shows a tomato leaf with:
- Mottled green/yellow coloration across the surface
- Visible concentric ring/ring-spot patterns
- Scattered small dark/brown necrotic spots
- Some darkening at leaf margins

This pattern strongly suggests **Tomato_Spotted_Wilt_Virus** (TSWV) — known for ring-spot patterns, bronzing, and necrotic spots on leaves. Let me confirm with one reference image.

The reference image is essentially identical to the test image — same concentric ring-spot patterns, mottled green/yellow coloration, and scattered dark necrotic spots. Both are even from the same Bugwood source (IDs 5606270 and 5606275). This is a clear match.
